eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria: Patients with leptomeningeal metastasis may enroll.

Exclusion Criteria:
Patients with known leptomeningeal disease are excluded.

Inclusion Criteria:
Cohort C: Patients with leptomeningeal disease are eligible.
Exclusion Criteria:
Cohorts A and B only: Patients with leptomeningeal disease are excluded. This exclusion does not apply to Cohort C.

armGroups.label: Cohort C
armGroups.description: Dedicated cohort for patients with leptomeningeal disease.

armGroups.label: Cohorts A and B
armGroups.description: Patients with leptomeningeal disease are excluded from these cohorts only.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
Patients must have leptomeningeal metastasis.
Exclusion Criteria:
Patients with meningeal metastasis are excluded. There are no separate cohorts or exceptions.
